# Hash-pinned. pip install runs one step before ACCESS_TOKEN enters the environment, and
# a compromised release of any of these would then execute alongside a token that can
# write every private repo the owner can write. --require-hashes makes a swapped artifact
# fail the install instead of running.
#
# Covers sdists, universal wheels and every CPython 3.12 wheel, so the same file installs
# on the ubuntu-latest runner and on a maintainer machine. Regenerate if Python moves off 3.12.
